outcome: Time interval from induction to delivery
cohort: 586 nulliparous women undergoing term induction of labor
finding: Single dose dinoprostone or amniotomy alone were associated with a greater likelihood of uncomplicated vaginal birth compared to sequential dinoprostone dosing in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Women who required more than one dose of dinoprostone for cervical priming had a lower incidence of uncomplicated vaginal delivery compared to those who underwent amniotomy alone or a single dose of dinoprostone.
